title: Relative normalization under affine localization
statement: Let X,C,Y be schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], with C and Y affine, f:X→C quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and g:Y→C flat. Let M be a multiplicative submonoid of Γ(C,O_C). Equip Γ(Y,O_Y) with the Γ(C,O_C)-algebra structure induced by g, and assume it is the localization at M. Then the canonical relative-normalization comparison N(f pulled back to Y)→N(f)×_C Y is an isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-relative-normalization; def-pc-fibre-product]. No normality, reducedness, Noetherian or finiteness assumption is made.

source.place: Tag 0307 (lemma-integral-closure-localize), Tag 02KH; the proved private normalizationPullback_affine_localization calculation

proof.text: Apply qcqs flat base change of sections to f and to its integral relative-normalization morphism, over the top affine opens of C and Y. This identifies both section rings with the corresponding tensor products, via the two canonical pushoutSection isomorphisms.

Use TensorProduct.toIntegralClosure_bijective_of_isLocalization followed by the section-ring algebra equivalence to obtain a bijection on integral closures. Compare its Spec with the canonical normalizationPullback by checking coefficients and the integral-closure inclusion; normalizationObjIso_hom_val and toNormalization_normalizationPullback_fst identify the maps. The comparison restricted to the top open is therefore invertible. Zariski locality on the top open gives the global isomorphism. This affine calculation is fully proved in Lean; no localization-at-a-prime reduction is used.
